data.name: issue_title
data.value: Hierarchical path-scoped resource section references (no flat-slug flattening) + anchor validation

data.name: problem_statement
data.value: A resource section is addressed by one flat GitHub-style slug, and two independent slug implementations disagree: the runtime resolver collapses whitespace runs and has no duplicate-heading dedupe, while the CI guard follows GitHub semantics — so a link can pass every automated check and still resolve to null at agent runtime (2 live cases). Separately, because the only namespace is the filename, a leaf heading cannot be addressed through its parent, so files repeating a heading expose only the first copy. Cost lands as either a hard get_resource failure or silent over-delivery, both invisible to CI.

data.name: classification_rationale
data.value: Composite issue classified by centre of gravity: 5 of 7 acceptance criteria concern new path-scoped addressing, guard coverage and tests, consistent with issue_type feature. Complex on five grounds — delegated delimiter decision, multiple viable AC-1 approaches, GitHub slug semantics vs byte-identical delivery hashes tension, gitnexus CRITICAL blast radius (18/17 symbols, 10 processes, 4 modules) reaching the delivery-ledger hashing path, and a cross-repo change from a red test baseline.

data.name: path_rationale
data.value: Full workflow, user-confirmed. Elicitation settles decisions only the user can make (delimiter, AC-1 slugger strategy, slug-semantics vs delivery-hash reconciliation, red-baseline scope, two-repo sequencing). Research pins exact github-slugger and CommonMark closing-fence semantics. Comprehension mandatory and load-bearing here.

data.name: open_questions
data.value: Q1-Q7 Resolved; Q8 -> implementation-analysis (bench:token run), Q9 -> requirements-elicitation (user scope decision), Q10 -> plan-prepare (design proposal); 4 out-of-scope follow-ups recorded

data.name: requirements
data.value: Slug-semantics unification plus a CI-visible ambiguity failure. 9 in-scope items: shared slugger module (no new dependency); differential guard check; third guard reason ambiguous-anchor (guard capability, not resolver behaviour); repoint the 7 live over-delivering prism-evaluate refs to -1; fix the 3 currently-red anchor links; prepare a workflows-branch worktree and bump the submodule pointer; tests for duplicate leaf slugs / -N addressing / single-segment back-compat / fenced-code headings; measure fence-hardening exposure; guard coverage of resources: [id#section] array entries. Path-scoped hierarchical addressing out of scope and deferred.

data.name: success_criteria
data.value: SC-1..SC-10 each with a verification method. SC-2 verified by direct resolver assertion (neither AC-2 link targets a resources/ file); SC-4 verified at the guard, not by a resolver throw; SC-5 needs a corpus-wide byte differential; SC-9 gates committing fence hardening on a counted exposure list; SC-10 requires code and corpus changes as separate commits.

data.name: scope_boundaries
data.value: In scope: 9 items. Out of scope: path-scoped addressing (AC 3, AC 4 multi-segment half, AC 6 path-ref half); adopting github-slugger; refactoring workflow resource files or referencers; renaming prism-evaluate duplicate headings; nested resource directories; widening extractMarkdownSection to a diagnostic Result; runtime error on an ambiguous bare slug (rejected on design grounds); committing guard fence hardening (held pending SC-9 count). Deferred: D-1..D-6.

data.name: elicitation_log
data.value: 9 question/response pairs across 5 domains, 5 clarifications, 5 resolved open questions, 2 requirements-not-taken
